prompt: 你想說「我每天通勤時都會聽一段英語對話」，哪句最自然？
options: I listen to a short dialogue on my way to work every day.
I listen a short dialogue on my way going to work every day.
I am listen to short dialogues in my way to work daily.
I listening a short dialogue at my work way every day.
answer: I listen to a short dialogue on my way to work every day.

wrong.I listen a short dialogue on my way goin: listen 後面要加 to，on my way to work 是固定片語，不必再加 going。
wrong.I am listen to short dialogues in my way: am 與 listen 重複，in my way 應為 on my way。
wrong.I listening a short dialogue at my work: listening 不能單獨當動詞，at my work way 不是正確搭配。

why: 習慣用現在簡單式；listen to 要加 to，on my way to work 是固定說法。
tip: listen 要加 to；on my way to 是固定片語。
say: I listen to a short dialogue on my way to work every day.

text: Learning on your own requires _____: you decide what to study and when.
options: autonomy
automation
autograph
autumn

wrong.automation: automation 是「自動化」，不是自己決定學習的能力。
wrong.autograph: autograph 是「親筆簽名」，句意不合。
wrong.autumn: autumn 是秋天，與句意無關。

why: 冒號後說明自己決定學什麼與何時學，這就是 autonomy（自主）。
tip: autonomy 是自己做決定的自主能力。
say: Learning on your own requires autonomy.

prompt: 這位學習者的做法是什麼意思？
text: I retell the dialogue without looking at the transcript, then review the parts I couldn't say.
options: 先不看稿重述，再複習說不出的地方
直接背誦全部逐字稿
完全不複習
只看稿子並朗讀
answer: 先不看稿重述，再複習說不出的地方

wrong.直接背誦全部逐字稿: 句中是 retell（重述），不是背誦逐字稿。
wrong.完全不複習: 句子最後明講 review the parts，表示有複習。
wrong.只看稿子並朗讀: without looking at the transcript 表示不看稿子。

why: retell without looking 是主動回想，再針對說不出的部分複習，屬於有效的學習策略。
tip: 先主動回想，再針對弱點複習。
say: I retell the dialogue without looking at the transcript.

prompt: 哪個 AI 提示語是把 AI 當成學習教練，而不是代寫工具？
options: Point out three grammar problems in my paragraph and explain why.
Write my whole paragraph so I can hand it in.
Make my paragraph perfect and don't explain.
Replace my paragraph with a better one.
answer: Point out three grammar problems in my paragraph and explain why.

wrong.Write my whole paragraph so I can hand i: 這是請 AI 代寫，學習者沒有練習到寫作。
wrong.Make my paragraph perfect and don't expl: 不要求解釋就無法學到自己錯在哪裡。
直接替換整段，學習者只拿到成品，沒有理解修改原因。

why: 要求指出問題並解釋原因，能讓學習者自己修改和理解，是教練式使用。
tip: 請 AI 指出並解釋問題，而不是代寫。
say: Point out three grammar problems and explain why.

prompt: 哪一句的 resilient 用法正確？
options: Resilient learners keep trying after they fail.
Resilient learners keeps trying after failing they.
Resilience learners keep to try after fail.
Resilient learner keep trying after they failure.
answer: Resilient learners keep trying after they fail.

wrong.Resilient learners keeps trying after fa: learners 是複數，動詞 keep 不加 s；failing they 語序也錯。
wrong.Resilience learners keep to try after fa: Resilience 是名詞，修飾 learners 要用形容詞 resilient；keep 後面接 -ing。
wrong.Resilient learner keep trying after they: learner 單數要配 keeps，failure 是名詞，應用動詞 fail。

why: keep + V-ing 表示持續做；after they fail 是完整子句，描述失敗之後。
say: Resilient learners keep trying after they fail.

text: Small daily habits create a _____ effect: each success makes the next one easier.
options: flywheel
firework
fireplace
flashlight

wrong.firework: firework 是煙火，與逐步累積動能不符。
wrong.fireplace: fireplace 是壁爐，無法比喻持續增強的效果。
wrong.flashlight: flashlight 是手電筒，不是累積動能的比喻。

why: flywheel 是飛輪，轉起來後越轉越順，比喻成功帶動下一次成功。
tip: flywheel effect 是越做越順的良性循環。
say: Small habits create a flywheel effect.

prompt: 你想問朋友「你每週花多少時間練英文口說」，哪句最自然？
options: How much time do you spend practicing speaking English each week?
How many time you spend to practice speaking English each week?
How much time you do spend practice speak English every week?
What time do you spending for speaking English in a week?
answer: How much time do you spend practicing speaking English each week?

wrong.How many time you spend to practice spea: time 不可數，要用 how much；問句要有助動詞 do。
wrong.How much time you do spend practice spea: 疑問句語序應是 do you spend，spend 後面接 -ing。
wrong.What time do you spending for speaking E: What time 問的是幾點，do 後面要用原形，不是 spending。

why: How much time do you spend + V-ing 是詢問花多少時間做某事的標準句型。
tip: spend time + V-ing，time 不可數用 how much。
say: How much time do you spend practicing speaking English each week?

text: Persistence matters more than talent when you are learning a language.
options: 持續努力比天分更重要
天分是學語言的唯一條件
學語言不需要努力
努力和天分都沒有用
answer: 持續努力比天分更重要

wrong.天分是學語言的唯一條件: 句子說 persistence matters more，不是天分。
wrong.學語言不需要努力: 句子強調持續努力的重要，並未說不需要。
wrong.努力和天分都沒有用: 句中沒有否定兩者，只是比較重要性。

why: matters more than 表示更重要，persistence 是堅持，talent 是天分。
tip: A matters more than B，表示 A 更重要。

prompt: 哪一句訂定學習目標的句子最清楚？
options: I will review ten new words every morning this month.
I will study English more hard in future.
I want maybe to learning many words sometimes.
I will be good English, I hope so.
answer: I will review ten new words every morning this month.

wrong.I will study English more hard in future: 目標籠統，more hard 也應為 harder，in future 也缺 the。
wrong.I want maybe to learning many words some: want 後面接 to V，不是 to learning；maybe 和 sometimes 讓目標模糊。
be good 後面要接介系詞 at，而且這句沒有可測量的做法。

why: 清楚的目標有數量、時間和做法：ten words、every morning、this month。
tip: 好目標要具體：數量加時間加方法。
say: I will review ten new words every morning this month.

text: Reading the same article twice helps you notice details you _____ the first time.
options: missed
miss
are missing
will miss

wrong.miss: the first time 指過去，要用過去式 missed，不能用原形。
wrong.are missing: 現在進行式表示正在進行，與過去的第一次不合。
wrong.will miss: will 表示未來，但 the first time 已發生。

why: the first time 是已發生的過去，所以填過去式 missed。
tip: 時間線索指過去，就用過去式。
say: Reading twice helps you notice details you missed the first time.

prompt: 朋友說他學不好，你想鼓勵他「進步是一點一滴累積的」，哪句最合適？
options: Progress comes little by little, so don't give up.
Progress comes little and little, so not give up.
Progress is coming a little by little, so no giving up.
Progress little by little comes, so don't to give up.
answer: Progress comes little by little, so don't give up.

wrong.Progress comes little and little, so not: 片語是 little by little，不能改成 little and little；not 也要寫成 don't。
wrong.Progress is coming a little by little, s: a little by little 不是正確片語，主詞後用進行式也不自然。
wrong.Progress little by little comes, so don': don't 後面不能接 to give，只能接原形動詞 give。

why: little by little 是「一點一滴」，後面 don't give up 是常見鼓勵語。
tip: little by little 是「逐漸」，別改字。
say: Progress comes little by little, so don't give up.
